title.note: The capability, e.g. 'Card authorization: release-date field'

about.note: The requirement or dependency id it serves

counterparty.note: Who answers at this step: a form or portal, the team's agent, or a person

owner.note: Who on our side or theirs moves it

lead_time.note: Expected weeks from sent to answered

evidence.note: The ticket, form, message or artifact id that shows where it stands
